status: Needs review — evidence-handling irregularity, corrected in this session's own text
finding: Manual retrieval of Polymarket's Gamma API through this project's page-retrieval path can be served from an HTTP cache. Market 5733288 behaved the same way: a cached state stamped 22:51:08Z read 0.69 / 0.31 while the cache-busted state stamped 23:17:08Z read 0.685 / 0.315. Consequences: (1) a manual read must be dated by the updatedAt inside its own payload, never by the moment of the read; (2) an earlier draft of this session's analysis text described the Aurora-9z line as having moved toward the favourite on the strength of a stale payload, and that text has been corrected to the full 0.685 -> 0.69 -> 0.685 sequence; (3) no published probability on this site was affected, because probabilities are produced only by the refresh on an Actions runner, which adjusts observation time for HTTP cache Age, and never from a hand-made read. Both receipts in research/day3-0e407ec7/quotes/ now carry a cache_warning and list every observation separately with its own stamp. Anyone doing hand-made market reads: cache-bust the URL.

status: Fixed in this change — awaiting scheduled-run proof
finding: Scheduled publish runs 38902730567 (12:46 UTC) and 38936303441 (17:00 UTC) on 16 October 2026, and the PR #41 push run, all passed verify-build and deployed successfully, then failed the step 'Verify live Pages bytes match this exact build' within about a second. Measured cause (GitHub Actions jobs API + the live build receipt): run 38936303441 built at 17:00:47Z, its deploy step ran 17:01:52-17:01:57Z, and verification fetched build-info.json once at 17:01:57Z while deployment 7124811549 was still updating (until 17:02:00Z), read the previous deployment's older bytes, and failed. The live site then served exactly that run's build (built_at 17:00:47Z, revision 40b13d3, 83 rows, read cache-busted at ~19:30Z): publication had succeeded; only the receipt failed, so every refresh looked broken while the board was in fact updating. The old verifier retried only on HTTP errors and never waited for propagation. Fix: scripts/verify_live.py polls with a fresh cache-busting query for up to six minutes until the live manifest is byte-identical to the run's manifest (or a provably newer byte-consistent build supersedes it), then hashes every file; older/torn/unreadable states still fail closed. Covered by tests/test_verify_live_9a81b26f.py (11 tests). Pages remains in legacy main:/ mode (Pages API: build_type legacy), so push-triggered runs still race GitHub's own pages-build-deployment of the committed root fallback; switching the Pages source to GitHub Actions would remove that race but changes repository settings and was not done from this branch. Proof standard: the next scheduled runs on main must show green deploy jobs with a polling receipt; until then this stays flagged.

The repository's Pages source is still the legacy branch build (`main:/`, read from the Pages API on 2026-10-17), so every merge to `main` also triggers a legacy rebuild of the committed root fallback, while the verified workflow publishes the refreshed artifact. Measured on 2026-10-17: at ~00:33 UTC the live `build-info.json` was the verified artifact revision `9029e8f1abcc4459bc1efe73638b8b7fcfb19735`, built 00:15:28Z, 96 rows, snapshot 00:15:28Z, 29 of 34 open fixtures priced; at ~00:37 UTC the same URL served revision `b13968ebe6fa6f308c3accc60780640d553d43ba`, built 00:27:40Z, 83 rows, snapshot 16 Oct 19:59:25Z, 17 of 21 open fixtures priced — the root fallback that merge `0d77fe9` (PR #55) refreshed and the legacy build then published. The freshness gate compares the live receipt with the commit being deployed (revision and a 60-minute snapshot budget) and re-publishes when either fails, and four scheduled slots an hour exist for exactly that, so the site converges again without intervention. This session tried the one-line fix — `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pages` with `build_type=workflow` — and the GitHub token available here returned 403 'Resource not accessible by integration'. Owner action, one step: repository Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source → GitHub Actions, after which the verified artifact is the only publisher and the root fallback stops being served.
